snippet.title: Roadside Research | Official Reveal Trailer | Xbox Partner Preview 2025
snippet.description:
Cybernetic Walrus and Oro Interactive are excited to confirm that Roadside Research will launch day one with Xbox Game Pass in 2026. 

Players on Xbox and PC will be able to jump into the game through Game Pass.

More details on release timing will be shared as we get closer to launch. 

Coming to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC as an Xbox Play Anywhere title.
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/roadside-research/9PFNXM9G4N83/0010
